answer.rationale: Current state: p99 latency 5x target on write path, release contains mandatory security patch (cannot rollback), settlement traffic at peak with heavy writes. Memory_b5 demonstrates that routing non-transactional queries to read replicas successfully reduced primary load and recovered latency the same day without impacting writes. This intervention: (1) respects the no-rollback constraint, (2) targets the write path bottleneck without blocking settlement, (3) has proven precedent, (4) is implementable within one intervention slot. Failover risks customer writes during peak settlement; add_capacity requires provisioning time we don't have; circuit breaker would shed writes during peak traffic (unacceptable). Read replica routing for observability/dashboard queries can immediately shed read load from primary, freeing capacity for write operations. This preserves the security patch requirement while addressing the latency spike.
